liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **He's Gone** (3 reviews): First performance of this song since PigPen's death, standing out among the year's shows; Masterful solo passages at the ten-minute mark highlight this performance [12][16][17]
- **Nobody's Fault But Mine Jam** (1 review): Sweet jam at the end of Truckin', with excellent specimens of other songs [14]

## The recordings

- **gd1973-03-19.141298.sbd.miller.patched.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 29 songs; 204 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer praises the soundboard quality and the work done by Charlie [13]
- **gd1973-03-19.sonyecm.moskal.97417.flac16**: source not stated; 28 songs; 207 min; rated 4.8/5 by 5 [3]. Said about its sound: Warm audience recording evokes the feeling of dancing in the back row; Audio levels fluctuate throughout the entire show, with dead air noted in several spots [3][11]
- **gd1973-03-19.141309.patched.sbd.mr.miller.flac1644**: soundboard; 29 songs; 204 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1973-03-19.sbd.123987.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 16 songs; 125 min [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer wishes the recording included the full interaction of the tapers getting caught [7]
- PigPen passed away one week before this performance took place [9]
- Crew member cut the mic cord, forcing the taper to surrender tapes to retrieve it [5]
- Reviewer considers this audience recording superior to the other one currently in circulation [6]
- First set considered potentially the best of 1973, despite other famous shows that year [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1973-03-19.141298.sbd.miller.patched.flac2496**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: flac24/96 Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info:WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master… [1]. Also: Two sets of masters were used to complete this show, with thanks to specific individuals [1]
- **gd1973-03-19.sonyecm.moskal.97417.flac16**: taped by Gerry Moskal; transferred by Gerry Moskal; source: Sony Stereo ECM x 2 -->SONY TCD126 [3]. Also: Taped secretly due to difficulty, this is the only complete record of the show [10]
- **gd1973-03-19.141309.patched.sbd.mr.miller.flac1644**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reels > Dat (16-bit/44.1k) > upsampled to 24-bit/96k; Mastering Info: WAV > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24; Master Reel… [2]
- **gd1973-03-19.sbd.123987.miller.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel -> Cassette -> Cassette -> Dat -> CD [4]
